name: Korvain Dynamics TactilEdge Combat Gloves
description:
Reinforced tactical gloves with hardened knuckle plates, palm-grip texturing, and articulated finger joints that allow full dexterity while providing impact protection. The back of each hand features a mounting point for accessory modules — flashlights, data jacks, biometric readers.

Standard issue for Korvain's private military contracts and widely adopted by independent security operators who need their hands to do more than just hold a weapon.
functionality: Impact protection, accessory mounting, full dexterity retention
what_it_says: Your hands are tools of controlled violence and you've equipped them accordingly.
story_hooks: A pair of TactilEdge gloves found at a crime scene have the biometric reader module still active — and it contains the fingerprints of its last three 'clients.'
